headlines: Word came from Oldspire that the bells rang twice for nothing, and no one will name who climbed the tower.
Mara Thistlewick arrived from Cradle Hollow with two pouches and a story she would not tell sober.
The matter of the long road north turned, and not for the better.
footnotes: The soup tonight was passable. No one complained, which is its own kind of compliment.
Old Tomas argued with the doorframe again. The doorframe held its ground.
Somewhere in the corner a tin whistle started up and stopped after eight notes.
